primitives.name: Falsifiable Hypothesis
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Issue 07: Edge lab micro-gain protocol ## Context The edge lab keeps small hypotheses testable and falsifiable.
primitives.assumptions: Hypotheses must be structured to allow for empirical disproof; each has a defined scope of applicability.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When hypothesis cannot be tested or contradicted by observation.

layer2.mapping: Each hypothesis maps to a conditional probability distribution in GSI's Bayesian model, where falsification corresponds to posterior probability collapse.
layer2.telemetry: Observation of outcome variance against predicted null hypothesis.

primitives.name: Micro-Gain Measurement
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Why It Matters Small gains should not be discarded, but they must be measured.
primitives.assumptions: Small gains are quantifiable only when measured under controlled conditions with sufficient statistical power.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When measurement error exceeds signal strength or sample size is insufficient.

layer2.mapping: Quantified marginal improvement mapped as a likelihood ratio in GSE's decision tree, enabling incremental policy updates.
layer2.telemetry: Statistical significance of observed effect size relative to baseline.
